# Asset Inventory and Credits

## Original assets generated by code

The first release uses original procedural geometry and materials generated at runtime by `src/engine/createWorld.ts`. There are no external 3D model, sound, texture or image downloads bundled in this archive.

| Asset | Format | Source / author | Licence / status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lunar surface, rocks and crater forms | PlayCanvas primitives | KSA OUTPOST 86 project code | Original project code; MIT project licence | Simplified fictional scene, not a terrain data product |
| Habitat, greenhouse, solar array, rover, water unit, antenna and shelter | PlayCanvas primitives | KSA OUTPOST 86 project code | Original project code; MIT project licence | Modular training environment |
| Astronaut character | Hierarchical PlayCanvas primitives | KSA OUTPOST 86 project code | Original project code; MIT project licence | Manually articulated and animated; not a third-party GLB |
| Stars and distant Earth visual | PlayCanvas primitives | KSA OUTPOST 86 project code | Original project code; MIT project licence | Decorative scene geometry |
| Interface icons and project symbol | Inline SVG / text / CSS | KSA OUTPOST 86 project code | Original project code; MIT project licence | Provisional text identity, not the official KSA school logo |

## Runtime dependency

- PlayCanvas Engine `2.24.0`, installed from NPM and bundled into the production application. The PlayCanvas Engine is open source under the MIT licence. See the [PlayCanvas Engine repository](https://github.com/playcanvas/engine) and [NPM package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/playcanvas).

## Fonts

The interface declares common font-family preferences with system fallbacks. No remote font file is required at runtime.

## Audio

No audio files are included in this first release.

## School logo

The official school logo was not supplied. `public/assets/branding/` is reserved for the approved artwork. The current “86” emblem is a provisional project mark and must not be described as the official school logo.
